reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is to improve model-selection UI flow by adding a one-click deselect control in the DSH web Settings Models fetch dialog, and it functions by detecting the dialog, adding a localized button, then unchecking listed model checkboxes and triggering change events for consistent client-side state.

summaries.zh: 该插件为 DSH 的模型获取弹窗新增“取消全选”按钮，让用户可一次性清空模型勾选项并重新设置选择状态。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a localized “Deselect all” button in the DSH model-fetch dialog so users can clear selected models in one action and keep selection state consistent.

capabilities: Injects and observes the DSH web client DOM to insert an extra dialog action button
Clears model selection checkboxes in bulk within the open fetch-models dialog
Dispatches standard change events so dialog state updates after bulk deselection
